stocks.name: Corpay
stocks.baseline_period: FY2026 management outlook normalized by analyst
stocks.terminal_earnings_period: FY2029 current-fiscal-year earnings estimate at Sep2029 exit
stocks.definition: Company adjustedEPS27.35 less aftertax SBC150m*74%/66mshares and aftertax annualized integration/dealcosts110.106m*74%/66m. SBCcharged; recurring integration allowancecharged. Amortization addback remains; this is analyst cash-earnings proxy, not GAAP or distributable FCF.
stocks.thesis: Corporate-payments organic growth can support high-single-digit per-share compounding without another acquisition or separate buyback-yield bonus.
stocks.countercase: Fuel/FX tailwinds reverse, integration proves recurring, regulatory expense and leverage absorb cash. Customer funds are not surplus corporate cash.
stocks.basis: The base grows normalized earnings9% annually versus reported10% group organic growth; it assumes no incremental buyback benefit. A16x terminal multiple is a discretionary allowance for recurring revenue but below a premium software multiple because leverage and payments regulation matter.
triggers: Two consecutive quarters group organic growth below5% with no credible temporary bridge
Management leverage above3.5x together with weak debt repayment, or loss of required facility access
Customer-funds shortfall, material compliance failure, or FTC outcome materially worse than provision
catalysts: Next quarterly report: organic corporate-payments growth and actual debt repayment
Resolution of preliminaryFTCsettlement; subsequent cash outflow compared with reserve
stocks.conditional_entry: Buy only at/below limit after weekly thesis/event check; AME requires published post-close funding bridge.
stocks.assumption_note: ScenarioEPSgrowth, terminalmultiples andfuturedividends are analyst judgments, not vendorconsensus or calibrated probabilities.

stocks.name: NetApp
stocks.terminal_earnings_period: FY2030 earnings estimate ending April2030; forward fiscal-year P/E at Sep2029 exit
stocks.definition: FY2027 GAAPEPS7.50, retainingSBC. Company adjustedEPS9.88 adds2.19SBC and otheritems; not used as interchangeable owner earnings.
stocks.thesis: All-flash storage and hybrid-cloud demand can compound, but the current share price already asks for sustained earnings and cash conversion.
stocks.countercase: Inventory, receivables and working-capital investment grow faster than durable cash receipts; quarterly growth normalizes while valuation compresses.
stocks.basis: BaseEPSgrowth10% is below recent30% revenuegrowth because rapid acceleration is not assumed permanent. Terminal21x GAAPearnings preserves aqualitypremium withSBCcharged. The bull needs12EPSand24x; the bear includes cyclical compression.
triggers: Two more quarters of weak operatingcashconversion without a numerical reversal of workingcapital timing
Inventory write-downs or inventoryturns remaining below8 while revenuegrowth dropsbelow10%
Gross-margin guidance reduced by morethan200basispoints from the current midpoint without a transitoryexplanation
catalysts: Next quarterly earnings: inventoryturns, cash conversion and FY2027guidance
stocks.conditional_entry: Buy only at/below limit after weekly thesis/event check; AME requires published post-close funding bridge.
stocks.assumption_note: ScenarioEPSgrowth, terminalmultiples andfuturedividends are analyst judgments, not vendorconsensus or calibrated probabilities.

stocks.terminal_earnings_period: FY2029 current-fiscal-year earnings estimate at Sep2029 exit
stocks.definition: Analyst normalizedEPS8.30 based on pre-close company adjusted8.20–8.30range plus0.05explicit assumedaccretion. Acquisitionamortizationexcluded;SBCremainsexpensed. No unverified proforma debt is asserted as actual.
stocks.thesis: High-quality niche industrial businesses and cash generation deserve a premium, but a$5bnacquisition andnear30xcurrent adjustedearnings leave limited margin for integration or rerating risk.
stocks.countercase: Acquisition earnings accretion does not cover increased capital employed or economic funding costs; organicorders soften andpremiumvaluation normalizes.
stocks.basis: Base9%earningsgrowth and24xmultiple recognize durable industrialquality. At the corroboratedprice the basecase return isinsufficient. A185reconsiderationlevel includes aprice buffer belowPVceiling; freshbuy stillrequires actual closingdebt andinterestbridge.
triggers: Published post-close netdebt/EBITDAabove3.5x without credible nearterm deleveraging
catalysts: First post-Indicor quarterly filing with actualdebt, interest andacquiredearnings
Organic sales andmargin evidence separate from acquiredrevenue
